verdict.rationale: The evidence supports the downloaded-models part of the story: the REST API is described as able to manage models, and users praise `ollama pull` and `ollama rm` for adding and removing models, with one user calling model management the area where Ollama beats llama.cpp. Nothing in the pack covers saved prompts or per-model configuration, and one user complains that Ollama hides server configuration behind its own defaults. Missing for 10: saved/reusable prompt management, per-model configuration settings, a single unified management view covering all three.
